title: "DEAR MAN Script Builder"
description: "Build a factual, respectful script for an objective-priority request or boundary."
sidebar: tool-finder
page-layout: full
toc: false
---

Use this tool when your main priority is **getting an objective met**: asking for something, saying no, requesting a change, or resolving a practical problem. If your main priority is strengthening the relationship, use the **[DEAR GIVE tool](/tool-finder/dear-give/)**. If your main priority is protecting self-respect or acting consistently with your values, use the **[DEAR FAST tool](/tool-finder/dear-fast/)**.

Write the result as a script you could realistically say out loud. Keep the wording factual, truthful, respectful, and non-manipulative. Rehearsing the script can help you clarify the request and visualize staying on topic during the conversation.

User-entered data stays in your browser and is not uploaded by this tool. Save the Markdown (`.md`) file if you want to resume later; export DOCX or print/save as PDF if you want a readable copy for printing or sharing with your therapist.

[Learn DEAR + MAN before building a script](/learn/interpersonal-effectiveness/dear-man.html)

::: {.callout-tip title="Which DEAR skill fits?"}
- **Objective priority:** DEAR MAN — focus on obtaining a concrete result.
- **Relationship priority:** [DEAR GIVE](/tool-finder/dear-give/) — focus on the relationship while making the request.
- **Self-respect priority:** [DEAR FAST](/tool-finder/dear-fast/) — focus on your values and self-respect while making the request.
:::
